issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation says 'Chúa Giê-xu làm và làm báp têm nhiều môn đồ hơn Giăng' (Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John), but the Greek text 'ποιει και βαπτιζει η ιωαννης' indicates that it is John who is doing the baptizing. The Greek structure implies: 'the Pharisees heard that Jesus makes more disciples AND [that] John baptizes'.
